rules.description: Link original store/receipt, order/invoice and line/SKU exactly; retain unresolved requests without accusation.

provenance.note: Original transaction lookup and return quantities are product concepts; exact synthetic composite joins and quarantine precedence are conservative sample implementation choices.

rules.description: Only a confirmed original single-card payment can support a review proposal, bounded by authorization.

provenance.note: The public linked-refund prerequisite is not permission to issue money. The fixture contains a reference, never a token.

rules.description: Do not mistake offline history for live availability or recompute original paid tax.

provenance.note: Offline quantity freshness and preserving original tax are source-backed concepts; the exact cumulative allocation below is sample policy.

rules.description: Require complete explicitly mapped exports, exact field sets and integer domains; reject duplicate or ambiguous primary evidence rather than coerce, deduplicate or guess.

provenance.note: Synthetic schema, 2099 dates, SYN- identifiers and fail-closed validation are corpus policy.

rules.description: Require a certified complete opening history strictly before period_start; pending, non-opening or mislinked history quarantines its entire order.

provenance.note: Closed-opening export certification and whole-order quarantine are invented safeguards; no actual source freshness is verified.

rules.description: Require period_start <= requested_on <= period_end <= as_of and purchase <= request with age <= window_days, all calendar-date comparisons inclusive.

provenance.note: The configurable company return window is not a legal entitlement or universal policy.

rules.description: Require original returnability and membership in configured reason and condition sets; exclusions propose zero.

provenance.note: Recording return reasons is source-backed; the allowed values and condition checks are invented policy.

rules.description: For original quantity Q and paid merchandise M/tax T, allocate each independently by integer ROUND_HALF_UP(amount*q/Q).

provenance.note: This penny policy is not a claim about Commerce internal rounding. No current catalog price or tax rate is an input.

rules.description: Original line money must equal capture <= authorization. Posted prior quantity must fit fulfilled quantity and prior merchandise/tax must equal cumulative entitlements; otherwise quarantine the whole order.

provenance.note: Our stricter captured-money and separate historical tax controls exclude fees, shipping and unreported tenders.

rules.description: Process requests by requested_on then request_id; subtract prior and earlier proposals. Partial-enabled proposes min(request,remaining); partial-disabled oversized requests consume nothing.

provenance.note: Deterministic batch reservation and partial-request policy are invented. Only the hypothetical proposal ledger changes.

rules.description: Allocate each proposal as the difference of cumulative merchandise/tax entitlements before and after its proposed quantity; recheck whole-order caps before release.

provenance.note: Cumulative differences conserve original pennies across partial requests; local calculations grant no financial authorization.

rules.description: Emit every request, line eligibility, order/currency controls and a human review packet with action_authorized false.

provenance.note: No refund, order amendment, stock return, customer contact, fraud finding or native publication is performed.

steps.title: Load independent mock exports
steps.procedure: Resolve the five logical source roles through source_files inside the bundle; report actual counts and configured dates without filesystem or service lookup.

steps.title: Validate schema, keys and domains
steps.procedure: Check exact shapes, synthetic identifiers, 2099 dates, integer quantities/money, vocabulary, uniqueness and order foreign keys. Reject the first structural error with an explicit result.

steps.title: Link receipt and original line evidence
steps.procedure: Join unique store/receipt, verify order/invoice, then line/SKU. Unknown receipts stay unresolved. Collect all implicated orders from contradictory identifiers before allocating anything.

steps.title: Reconcile original payment and opening returns
steps.procedure: Check complete-before certification, event status/date/line references, original totals, payment confirmation and cumulative posted entitlements. Retain raw observed history; mark authoritative eligibility null for every line of a quarantined order.

steps.title: Evaluate dates, returnability, reason and condition
steps.procedure: Evaluate matched, nonquarantined requests in the documented precedence. Record actual age and all policy exclusion codes; exclusions consume nothing.

steps.title: Reserve hypothetical quantities in order
steps.procedure: Walk requested_on/request_id order against each original line. Record posted prior, earlier proposals, available, proposed and deferred units, including explicit oversized and exhausted outcomes.

steps.title: Allocate original merchandise and tax pennies
steps.procedure: Capture cumulative before/after amounts, subtract independently for merchandise and tax, then verify prior plus proposals against captured and authorized money. No tax rate or current price lookup occurs.

steps.title: Surface order quarantine and request review
steps.procedure: Publish deterministically ordered order exceptions followed by request exceptions. Whole-order quarantine includes requests earlier in the batch, and never hides uncertain history as zero.

steps.title: Publish review-only proposal and controls
steps.procedure: Emit the exact common result envelope containing every request, every original line/order, separate currency controls and the non-authorizing review packet. Preserve unresolved and zero-proposal rows.
